taskNotes: Ankou require 40 combat to be assigned and have no Slayer level or quest requirement.
Ankou attack with relatively inaccurate melee and a max hit from 8 to 10; Protect from Melee negates all damage.
Ankou are undead, so Salve amulet variants can boost accuracy and damage.
Salve amulet bonuses do not stack with Slayer helmet or Black mask; use the better option for the player's stats and gear.
Unextended tasks are fast even with melee in single combat.
In multicombat areas such as Catacombs of Kourend and Wilderness Slayer Cave, Burst spells, Barrage spells, and Venator bow can be viable, but even extended tasks are consumed quickly.
Salve necklace effects do not apply to secondary monsters hit by area-of-effect spells.
Cannon may be used against Ankou in all listed locations except the Catacombs of Kourend.
Typical tasks yield dozens of Death runes and Blood runes; Catacombs kills can also drop Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.

Ankou are Spectral creatures, so Ectoplasmator grants Prayer experience; they also drop bones, so Bonecrusher or Bonecrusher necklace adds Prayer experience and restores one Prayer point per Catacombs kill.
In Wilderness locations, minimise risk and carry a one-click teleport usable in the 20-30 Wilderness range, such as a Royal seed pod.
recommendedMethod: Use melee for quick single-combat tasks, especially Stronghold of Security or Stronghold Slayer Cave. For Catacombs or Wilderness Slayer Cave, Burst/Barrage or Venator bow can clear tasks very quickly. Use cannon anywhere except Catacombs, and treat Wilderness locations as PK hotspots requiring low risk and a one-click teleport.
